issues.explanation: The adaptation says Sima Zhao built the earthworks and hoped rising water would break the city. In the source, Wei builds the earthworks to guard against the Huai River, while the besieged defenders hope flooding will destroy the earthworks and let them attack.
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite to assign the flood hope to the defenders: “司马昭筑土城防备淮水，寿春守军盼望水涨冲毁土城；但秋冬久旱无雨。”
